Six direct old/new controls show original senior rejects the interior line break while reference/junior pass; all final boards agree.

objective: Find the first literal orthogonal nonrepeating path in a letter grid.

relevanceRationale.presentDay: Grid search models constrained route exploration and backtracking.
relevanceRationale.practicalUtility: Combine row-major starts, ordered neighbors, rollback and visited membership.
relevanceRationale.transferable: Deterministic DFS, bounded exponential growth, literal strings and mutable output ownership transfer.
relevanceRationale.audienceFit: Fits the advanced recursion/nested-loop lesson after earlier grid traversal tasks.
relevanceRationale.riskOutcome: Missing rollback, cell reuse or normalization can return an invalid or nondeterministic path.

defects: Grid, word length and string-unit assumptions were unspecified.
Mutable fresh path/pair ownership and empty-grid behavior lacked checks.
ASCII-only examples accepted changing Unicode representation before search.
No authored cost accounted for the senior path-copying implementation.
rationale: Keep all three correct boards and skeleton. Define dense readonly≤8x8equal-length primitive rows, word≤8UTF16units, literal code-unit cells/case/representation, no diagonal/reuse/input mutation, first row-major/up-right-down-left path, fresh mutable outer/pairs even for empty word and null for an impossible nonempty path. Explicitly accept equivalent implementation styles rather than enforcing some on junior/alternative boards. ConservativeO(r*c*4^L*L)time/O(r*c+L^2)space counts path copying/scanning; marked implementations improve those factors. Add visible right-before-down tie and three hidden assertions:1008binary2x2grid/word cases against independent iterative path-stack oracle,11Unicode/empty/newline/case/literal/freshness models and8x8/eight-character/empty-repeat bounds. Independent flat typed visited-array DFS passes; NFC-normalizing wrong passed originals and now fails.
